purpose: Route lessons learned into crew competencies, validators, doctrine, task preflight/postflight and future allocation.

operational_policy.reuse_rule: Before repeating a task class, inspect applicable REX preventive controls; after execution record recurrence/resolution evidence rather than relying on crew memory.

entries.title: namespace/action-status collision
entries.learning_signal: Repeated ambiguity between entity/action/state names must trigger taxonomy repair before new automation is added.

entries.title: unregistered semantic vocabulary
entries.learning_signal: New terms are provisional until registered or mapped to canonical vocabulary.

entries.title: YAML line length
entries.learning_signal: Formatting defects that repeatedly block CI should be converted from human memory into automated lint gates.

entries.title: stale active-dock action namespace
entries.learning_signal: An action surface must not remain active merely because it existed in a previous wave.

entries.title: unbound promotion/proof gate
entries.learning_signal: No promotion may occur without a named proof gate, evidence owner and accepted receipt.

entries.title: zero-step GitHub Actions preexecution
entries.learning_signal: A workflow object is not execution evidence until a real runner is assigned and at least one step executes.

entries.title: CRLF bytes from Windows text writers drift pinned blob OIDs
entries.known_fix:
Open every text writer with newline="
" and encoding="utf-8" (Path.write_text turns 
 into 
 on Windows). .gitattributes keeps * text=auto eol=lf. Strip CR from a file that was already written (sed -i 's/$//') before you commit it.
entries.learning_signal: When a pinned output disagrees with its git blob only on Windows, the line endings are wrong. The content did not change.

entries.title: pinned generated outputs stale after a pinned-source change
entries.known_fix: Commit the source change first. Then run python mission-control/jade_temple/tools/regen.py --write, which regenerates the DAG, the page and the launcher in order, and commit the result. The launcher reads blob OIDs at a commit, so a launcher built before its inputs are committed is stale. Verify with regen.py --check.
entries.learning_signal: A change to any DAG-pinned file takes two commits: the source change, then the regenerated outputs.

entries.title: second session on a live PR branch duplicates the fix
entries.known_fix: Before you edit a PR branch, run git fetch origin <branch> and compare the result with gh pr view --json headRefOid. The main checkout fetches master only, so origin/<branch> can be hours old. Also run tools/workstation/Invoke-DraftPrPass.ps1. If it classes the PR as LIVE, or the head is less than 30 minutes old, leave the PR to that session.
entries.learning_signal: A stale remote-tracking ref hides a live session. Ask the remote, not the local ref.

entries.title: addressed bot review threads left unresolved keep first-pass-closure red
entries.known_fix: Check each unresolved Codex, Copilot or CodeQL thread against the current head. If it is fixed, reply with the fixing SHA and file:line, then resolve the thread (addPullRequestReviewThreadReply, then resolveReviewThread). If it is not fixed, fix it and push. Codex re-reviews the new head and can raise new findings, so run the pass again until it reports 0.
entries.learning_signal: An outdated thread is still open. First-pass closure counts open threads, not fixed code.

entries.title: stale GITHUB_TOKEN in an inherited shell returns 401 from gh
entries.known_fix: Run gh with the token variables removed so the keyring login is used. In bash: unset GITHUB_TOKEN GH_TOKEN. In PowerShell: Remove-Item Env:GITHUB_TOKEN,Env:GH_TOKEN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue. Then remove the User or Machine value and restart the parent app. Never print the token.
entries.learning_signal: On this workstation, a 401 from gh means a stale environment variable until shown otherwise. Check that before you suspect a permission problem.
